# Valhalla Construction LLC

> Remodeling & General Contractor in Washington County, UT. Logan and Valhalla Construction take on remodels, full renovations and home improvement projects. Customers say he gives fair, honest bids, keeps them updated, and gets the work done quick and clean.

## Services
- Remodels & renovations: Full home renovations and remodels, start to finish.
- Custom spaces: A home gym, or a table nook turned into a coffee bar.
- Porches & paint: Old paint stripped and porches repainted so they look brand new.
- Lights & outlets: New lights and outlets added right where you need them.

## Service area
- Washington County, UT

## Questions customers ask
- **Do you do full renovations?** Yes. One couple bought a home that needed a full renovation and could not be more pleased with the results.
- **Can you build a custom space?** Yes. One customer had a home gym built and a table nook turned into a coffee bar.
- **Do you do smaller jobs too?** Yes. Customers mention a back porch stripped and repainted, and new lights and outlets added.
- **Will you keep me updated?** Customers say Logan is very communicative and kept them informed throughout the project.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
